title: Sub-objects

predict.test: the numbers ≥ 1 are not an additive submonoid
predict.statement: With only the axiom "closed under `+`", the numbers `≥ 1` would be accepted as an additive submonoid.
`{0, 1}` is closed under multiplication; it is still not an additive submonoid of ℕ.

public: the even numbers are an additive submonoid of ℕ
